name: Voxel Grid Decoders
definition: A volume decoder that models the volume function V(x; z) as a discrete 3D grid of voxels, producing an explicit 3D voxel grid as the output tensor of a neural network, avoiding the prohibitive size requirements of MLPs for high-quality reconstructions.
summary: Voxel Grid Decoders generate explicit 3D voxel grids from latent codes, trading memory for speed to enable real-time rendering by avoiding per-ray MLP evaluations.
